# dbm 0.1.1

This patch release makes the BB plugin installable from an immutable Git tag
and keeps the CLI on GitHub-only distribution.

## Install the CLI

```sh
bun add --global https://github.com/celeroncoder/dbm/releases/download/v0.1.1/celeroncoder-dbm-0.1.1.tgz
dbm doctor
dbm
```

## Install the BB plugin

```sh
bb plugin install git:https://github.com/celeroncoder/dbm.git@v0.1.1 --plugin dbm --yes
bb dbm images
```

The shared core package now lives inside the BB plugin root, so BB's managed
Git source build can resolve Effect without installing dependencies at the
repository root. The CLI packages and re-exports that same core source.

## Supported managed images

- PostgreSQL: `postgres:16-alpine`
- MySQL: `mysql:8.4`
- Redis: `redis:7-alpine`
- MongoDB: `mongo:7`

The CLI can also discover common compatible images, including MariaDB,
Valkey, PostGIS, and pgvector, when their native database client and expected
environment conventions are available.

## Compatibility and known limits

- Bun 1.4 or newer
- Docker Engine reachable from Linux or macOS
- BB 0.39 or newer for the plugin
- Windows is unsupported; WSL2 is experimental
- Local trusted-development use only; remote and production database
  management are out of scope

The release includes the package tarball, SHA-256 checksums, and an SPDX JSON
SBOM. Nothing is published to a package registry. Uninstall the CLI with
`bun remove --global @celeroncoder/dbm`; remove the plugin with
`bb plugin remove dbm`.
